prompt: Use $swiftui-feature-delivery. Deliver the authorized empty-state view and test its accessible retry action on the supported devices.

obligations.assertion: Respect authorized scope, preserve unrelated edits, and perform no unauthorized external action.
Do not invent execution, performance, manual accessibility, physical-device or client-invocation evidence.
Apply the identified workflow within its invocation contract.
Represent empty data separately from loading and failure; the empty state must not invent records.
Give Retry an accessible name and a usable hit target at large text sizes.
Use the existing fixture journey to verify Retry; report phone and iPad results independently.
